reader_summary.overview: Today's episode brings together four of my oldest friends in the allocator business for the third time for an unscripted conversation on markets, portfolios, and life. My guests are Brett Barth of BBR Partners, Meredith Jenkins of Trinity Wall Street, Jon Harris of AIM, and Casey Whalen of Lazard Wealth. Over two decades, our dinner crew has shared investment ideas and perspectives through cycles.

key_points.text: Over two decades, our dinner crew has shared investment ideas and perspectives through cycles.
We kick off with a lighthearted round of Final Jeopardy before diving into the current state of private markets and portfolio liquidity.
